 Hon'Ble Abdul Shahid, J. 
1.
Heard learned counsel for the revisionists, learned counsel appearing for opposite party no. 2 and the learned A.G.A. for the State.
Perused the material placed on record.

2. Under challenge is the impugned order dated 18.10.2024 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (E.C. Act), Meerut, in Sessions Trial No. 488 of 2011 (State Vs.
Ashwani) arising out of case crime no. 317 of 2007, under Section 63/68A Copy Right Act, Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration (PFA) Act, 1954 and Sections 272, 420, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station Kankarkhera, District Meerut, whereby the application No. 67 Kha under Section 239 Cr.P.C. of the revisionist has been rejected 3.

sentences.text: The allegations against the accused revisionists are that they had manufactured desi ghee.

At the time of incident sixteen peti of adulterated desi ghee with the mark of Vishwas Premium of 2 kg and kg in tins and polythene packs, were recovered?nine tins from the steam vehicle and seven tins from the Maruti car.

Besides this, various articles and equipment used for making adulterated ghee,
including 1. two air gun, 2. two Cars, 3. two sealing machines, 4. one stove, 5. one Indian cylinder, 6.
large karaha, 7. large bhagona, 8. large iron tub, 9. one machine with motor,10. one big gas furnace,11. seven empty tins,12. nine plastic containers,13. one jug, 14.tins of cream and Vishwas Premium wrappers and polythene packets, were recovered from the spot and taken into police custody.
When asked about the goods loaded in the steam and Maruti vehicles, factory owner Rajesh Sharma stated that the same were being taken to be supplied to nearby people.
4. After investigation, the charge sheet has been filed against the accused persons.

5. Learned counsel for the revisionists has submitted that the impugned order passed by the Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (E.C. Act), Meerut dated 18.10.2024 is illegal and bad in the eye of law.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (E.C. Act), Meerut
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It has been passed without entering into the merits of the case.
Learned trial court has not discussed the evidence produced by the revisionists and did not apply his judicial mind.
6. Learned counsel for the revisionists has submitted that neither revisionists were manufacturing nor selling desi ghee when they had been arrested, as alleged by the police.
The investigating officer recovered item sealed and it was sent on 22.7.2007 for examination, investigating officer stated that the said item was sent to Forensic Laboratory, Agra on 12.8.2007.
The same was again sent to Forensic Laboratory, Lucknow, but without any result, it was returned to police station Kankerkhera, District Meerut on 23.10.2007.
It is further submitted that the report of recovered amount should be prepared within 45 days, but the same was never tested within stipulated time.
Therefore, the impugned is absolutely illegal and the same is liable to be set aside.
7. Learned counsel for opposite party no. 2 opposed the revision and contended that the investigation has been completed.
The evidences had been collected against the revisionists, hence the objection raised by the learned counsel for the revisionists could be seen at the stage of the trial.
The impugned order is liable to be confirmed and the revision is liable to be dismissed.

sentences.text: I have considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
9. The learned trial court has passed a reasoned order and mentioned all the recovery materials at the spot and perused the statements of the witnesses.
The accused/revisionists were found in manufacturing adulterated desi ghee.
As per the investigating officer, the accused does not possess any licence and they are not having authority of the original company.
The learned trial court has specifically mentioned that the forensic report is on the file and as per which, the alleged desi ghee is not of original company, but it is adulterated.

The contention raised by the learned counsel for the revisionists that Forensic Science Laboratory has not submitted its report within 45 days, that is the matter of trial and its implication would be seen by the trial court at the appropriate stage after appraisal of the evidence produced before the court of law.
10. In view thereof, there is no legal force in the submissions of the learned counsel for the revisionists and the present criminal revision is liable to be dismissed.
It is dismissed, accordingly.
(Abdul Shahid,J.) October 31, 2025 M. Tarik  Pradeep And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 31 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2952591/
